Package com.bookmap.addons.broadcasting.api.view

Interface BroadcasterProvider

All Superinterfaces:
Broadcaster
public interface BroadcasterProvider extends Broadcaster
A class for operating the library as an event provider. To do this you need to register your generators in the registerGenerator() method. And also when your generator generates events, you should send them to all listeners who subscribe to you, you can get them in the getListenersLiveDates() method.

      void registerGenerator(String generatorName, Set<Class<? extends Event>> events, EventFilter<?> filter, Object settings)
      You should register generators from which consulters can receive events.
      Parameters:
      generatorName - - Name of the generator.
      events - - The classes of events that the generator broadcasts.
      filter - - An event filter through which the consumer can filter your events.
      settings - - The settings of your generator. For generator status information only.
